description: What ended and what was done in a time range: every incident episode that resolved in it (when it started and ended, how long, who had it acknowledged, whether a source or someone by hand resolved it, any confirmation) and, newest first, the acknowledgements, silences, reopens and confirmations people and agents made, each with who. Give `from` and `to` as ISO times, or `hours` back from now (24 by default). Watch keeps 30 days.

from.description: ISO 8601 start of the range, for example 2026-10-14T00:00:00Z.

hours.description: Instead of from: this many hours before `to`. Default 24.

limit.description: How many rows at most (default 100, most 200).

service.description: Only services whose name contains this, any case.

to.description: ISO 8601 end of the range. Default now.

name: incident_history
title: Incident history
